title: Ministry of Justice Dismisses Eduardo Bolsonaro for Abandonment of Office
seoTitle: Eduardo Bolsonaro Fired by Ministry of Justice
subtitle: Former Federal Deputy Loses Post After Accusations of Abandoning Duties
excerpt: The Ministry of Justice and Public Security has dismissed Eduardo Bolsonaro, citing abandonment of office.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Ministry of Justice and Public Security has dismissed former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro from his position.

The decision was made under the allegation of abandonment of office, as disclosed by the ministry itself.

With the dismissal, Eduardo Bolsonaro leaves his post at the Ministry of Justice and Public Security.

With information from Agência Brasil.
